thread:
maria: Heads-up  new POC with HelixCare. They want real-time row ingestion from streaming function-calls into their data warehouse (ingester webhook). Key asks: per-row streaming, deterministic JSON schema, enterprise SSO + customer KMS. They're nervous about runaway token costs.
omar: Cool. Do they expect every partial token to be sent as a row, or batched rows?
maria: They want rows as events arrive (near realtime). Ideal is each analysis row emitted as soon as intent+entities resolved.
lee: Streaming+function-calls doable but we need to align on format. Two approaches: 1) Strict function-calls returning complete JSON objects per call (safer), 2) NDJSON chunks emitted token-by-token for the lowest latency but clients must reassemble.
sasha: For reliability I'd push strict function-calls, model returns array of objects, we stream one object when ready. If they insist on sub-object streaming we recommend delimiting records with a non-printable separator (e.g. ) to avoid JSON parse issues.
omar: On KV caching: live streams with back-and-forth tool calls can stale the prefix cache and produce inconsistent rows. We patched this in staging but not rolling to prod in Dedicated. Workaround: enable short TTL (1-3s) or disable prefix caching for that route. Side effect: ~10% token increase.
lee: For cost math: they expect 300 concurrent streams, avg 45s sessions, avg emitted rows per session = 4, avg tokens per row = 280. Quick calc i ran: 300*4 rows per 45s => ~26.7 rows/sec. At 280 tokens => ~7.5k tokens/sec => ~27M tokens/hr. Hosted unit pricing will determine dollars.
maria: They asked for a Hosted quote first. Omar, can you produce hosted vs dedicated numbers with an example monthly commit that shows break-even?
omar: Yep. I'll model hosted at $0.0009 per 1k output tokens and dedicated unit-rate at $0.00055 per 1k after commitment. I'll include burst pricing and sandbox credit line items.
sasha: Security note: they require KMS-managed keys for model input storage if we persist logs. Hosted can do envelope encryption but they explicitly said customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own) is mandatory for production. Private deployment is the only full match.
maria: We'll position Hosted for evaluation with clear caveats: no BYOK, short retention, dedicated available for production. Also need to complete their security questionnaire item about third-party tool calls and PII.
lee: Answer for questionnaire: our platform doesn't automatically forward data to external third parties. If function-calls invoke customer endpoints or third-party tools, those payloads go to the invoked service and are subject to their handling. Put that in the runbook.
sasha: Runtime constraints: function-calling + streaming sometimes requires buffering until function args complete depending on model variant. If they need true incremental rows, NDJSON preferred; otherwise we can fake streaming by emitting completed rows as soon as we get full function responses. Latency tradeoff: NDJSON => lower wall time but harder to parse.
maria: Request: can we get a demo sandbox with KV-ttl toggle and NDJSON example for tomorrow afternoon? I'll present to their eng leads.
deploy-bot: Staging deployment successful: ndjson-demo toggles + kv-ttl control rolled to sandbox-alpha (build 4992). URL: https://sandbox-alpha.redwood.test/ndjson-demo
omar: I'll prepare the pricing sheet and a 1-page runbook: 1) Use strict function-calling where possible; 2) If per-token streaming required use NDJSON with record-sep; 3) For live sessions set KV TTL=2s or disable; 4) Provide traffic profile (concurrency, avg rows, tokens); 5) Security questionnaire answers + BYOK path for Private.
maria: Perfect. Sasha/Lee, can you validate the example JSON schema I'll send (fields: row_id, ts_iso, event_type, intent, confidence, entities)? Lee pls ensure types map to our function signature enforcement.
lee: Will do. I'll also include sample curl webhook with newline-delimited payloads and sample parser snippets (node/python).
sasha: I'll prep the security language for the questionnaire and loop in legal for the PII/tool-call section.
maria: Action items: maria (customer comms & schedule demo), omar (pricing + hosted vs dedicated delta), lee (schema + sample code), sasha (security questionnaire + legal). Target demo: tomorrow 2pm PT.
omar: Draft contract clause for BYOK + SOC2 in the conversion to Dedicated. Include 30-day eval credit and a conversion discount.
maria: Thanks everyone. I'll confirm the demo time with HelixCare and send calendar invite.
